note: Educational profiles describe styles and grapes, not named producers or specific vintages. Bottle illustrations are original and not actual winery labels.

wines.name: Cabernet Sauvignon
wines.character: Structured, dry, often oak-aged; firm tannins soften with age.
wines.service: Young concentrated examples may benefit from 30–60 minutes of air.

wines.name: Pinot Noir
wines.aromas: Red cherry, raspberry, rose, forest floor
wines.character: Silky, aromatic and relatively light in tannin.
wines.service: Usually little or no decanting, especially for delicate mature bottles.

wines.name: Merlot
wines.character: Softer texture and rounder fruit than many Cabernet-focused blends.
wines.service: A short aeration can help younger examples.

wines.name: Syrah / Shiraz
wines.character: Rhône styles lean savory; warmer climates can be richer and fruitier.
wines.service: A young, intense bottle can benefit from a short decant.

wines.name: Tempranillo (Rioja)
wines.character: Savory red fruit with oak notes in barrel-aged Rioja styles.
wines.service: Reserva and Gran Reserva can be pleasant after brief aeration.

wines.name: Chianti Classico
wines.character: Brisk acidity and savory character suit tomato-based dishes.
wines.service: Optional short aeration; serve slightly cool.

wines.name: Barolo / Nebbiolo
wines.character: High acidity and tannin with pale color and complex aromatics.
wines.service: Young bottles often benefit from a decant; handle aged bottles gently.

wines.name: Malbec
wines.character: Rich dark fruit and approachable structure in many Mendoza examples.
wines.service: A short decant can open young, full-bodied examples.

wines.name: Beaujolais / Gamay
wines.character: Juicy, fresh, low-tannin red; often enjoyable slightly chilled.
wines.service: No decanting normally needed.

wines.name: Dry Riesling
wines.character: High acidity, aromatic citrus and a crisp finish; this entry is the dry style.
wines.service: No decanting normally needed.

wines.name: Chardonnay
wines.aromas: Yellow apple, lemon curd, butter, toast
wines.character: Unoaked styles are leaner; oak and lees aging can bring creaminess.
wines.service: Avoid serving rich styles ice-cold.

wines.name: Sauvignon Blanc
wines.aromas: Grapefruit, gooseberry, cut grass, passion fruit
wines.character: Zesty aromatic white; herbaceous intensity varies by region.
wines.service: Best served fresh rather than decanted.

wines.name: Pinot Grigio
wines.character: Light-bodied, delicate and dry; some versions are richer and textured.
wines.service: Best served fresh.

wines.name: Chenin Blanc
wines.character: Versatile grape spanning bone-dry through sweet; this profile is lightly off-dry.
wines.service: Adjust pairing to the bottle's actual sweetness.

wines.name: Grüner Veltliner
wines.aromas: Green apple, white pepper, citrus, herbs
wines.character: Dry, refreshing and food-flexible with distinctive peppery notes.
wines.service: No decanting normally needed.

wines.name: Gewürztraminer
wines.character: Powerfully aromatic, with modest acidity; sweetness varies widely.
wines.service: Check the label for actual sweetness.

wines.name: Provence Rosé
wines.character: Dry, pale, refreshing and delicate.
wines.service: Drink young for freshness.

wines.name: Tavel Rosé
wines.character: Deeper-colored, fuller-bodied rosé suitable for substantial dishes.
wines.service: A little warmer than pale rosés.

wines.name: Brut Champagne
wines.character: Traditional-method sparkling wine; fine bubbles and toasty lees character.
wines.service: Chill, but not so cold that aromatics disappear.

wines.name: Prosecco Brut
wines.character: Typically fruit-forward sparkling wine made by tank fermentation.
wines.service: Best fresh, no decanting.

wines.name: Cava Brut
wines.character: Traditional-method Spanish sparkling with savory, dry finish.
wines.service: Serve chilled in a white-wine glass if possible.

wines.name: Ruby Port
wines.character: Sweet fortified wine with rich berry flavors.
wines.service: Serve smaller portions; often no decant for basic Ruby styles.

wines.name: Sauternes
wines.character: Lusciously sweet dessert wine balanced by acidity.
wines.service: A small pour goes a long way.

wines.name: Tokaji Aszú
wines.aromas: Dried apricot, orange peel, honey, ginger
wines.character: High-acid sweet wine made with botrytized grapes; intensity depends on style.
wines.service: Check sweetness level and producer guidance.

wines.name: Moscato d'Asti
wines.character: Low-alcohol, gently sparkling sweet wine.
wines.service: Chill well and serve promptly after opening.
